items.title: Sandisk (SNDK) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower As Analysts Weigh AI Demand And Cyclicality
items.summary: Sandisk’s fair value estimate has been trimmed from US$2,105.29 to US$2,047.38. This marks a measured reset of expectations rather than a wholesale rethink of the story. Analysts are weighing long term AI and NAND demand against questions on valuation and industry cyclicality, which helps explain why the price target moves are incremental instead of extreme.
